description: Use of the existing building and open land for storage and distribution (B8), including provision of hard-standing and soft landscaping, erection of new fencing and gates; CCTV and lighting columns and a vehicle wash with associated drainage works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 1010/SK 06 - layout of shelter, New Sheffield - BXMW/SEF details, HO-PUL-700A - cycle shelter, HO-PUL-600 - lighting and CCTV layout, Travel Plan Strategy Doc Ref RTPS/v 1.1 January 2013, Transport Statement Doc Ref RTS/v1.2 January 2013, HO-PUL-501 - section and finished floor levels as proposed, HO-PUL-500 - section and finished floor levels as existing, HO-PUL-400 Rev A Fencing Layout, HO-PUL-302 East elevation showing context, HO-PUL-301 Elevations as proposed, HO-PUL-300 Elevations as existing, HO-PUL-201 roof layout as proposed, HO-PUL-101 ground and first floor layout as proposed, HO-PUL-1001 A - proposed lighting layout, 3614/505 - Hydro brake and flow control chamber, 3614/504 - sections, 3614/503 - general arrangement showing storm water attenuation, 3614/502 - foul and surface water catchments, 3614/207 P2 - section through site and main access, 5 Pulborough Way - Lighting statement, Planning design & access statement January 2013, Contamination Statement dated 10/10/2012, Bird hazard management plan rev C - 30/01/2013 received 01/02/2013
Bird loafing deterrents, Heavy duty wash systems from Tammermatic Specification received 07/03/2013
3614/201 P5 - Location plan, 3614/202 P5 - site plan, 3614/204 P9 - proposed site plan, 3614/206 P7 - proposed block plan, 1358-01 C - proposed landscaping areas, 1358-02 C- proposed landscaping received 30/04/2013
 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The parking spaces as indicated on plan 1358-01C shall be permanently retained for use by Unit 678, Pulborough Way, Hounslow and shall not be used for any other purposes or by any other unit, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The cycle stands as indicated on plan HO-PUL-700A & New Sheffield - BXMW/SEF shall be permanently retained for use by Unit 678 Pulborough Way, Hounslow and shall not be used for any other purposes or by any other unit, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details HO-PUL-400 Rev A Fencing Layout received 01/02/2013 &1358-01 C - proposed landscaping areas, 1358-02 BC- proposed landscaping received 30/04/2013 .  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority.

Condition : 7 - (a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans 1358-01C received 30/04/2013 and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

Condition : 8 - The Bird Management Plan as shown in the approved document 'Bird Hazard Management Plan C' shall be implemented as approved upon completion of the site and shall remain in force for the duration of the use of the site hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The proposed lighting layout should be carried out  in accordance with the approved drawing HO-PUL-1001 Proposed lighting layout received 01/02/2013, and be thereafter maintained and retained as such.

Condition : 10 - Prior to occupation of the site, a Local Level Travel plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved travel plan.

Condition : 11 - The scheme for sustainable drainage shall be carried out in accordance with plan nos. 3614/502 and 3614/503 received 01/02/2013. The site shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use hereby permitted is commenced in accordance with the approved details as shown on drawing no. HO-PUL-400 Rev A Fencing Layout and thereafter maintained and retained as such.
